output.review_comment:
Two of the three fixes are correct. Counting started periods with `(days_late + 29) // 30` and rounding half up with `+ 5000` both match the docstring.

The swapped cap and minimum is not acceptable. The docstring says to apply the minimum first, then the cap, and that "the cap always wins, even when it brings the fee below the minimum fee." Applying the cap first and the minimum last makes the minimum win, which reverses the documented rule for every small balance. The PR description admits the swap exists only so that `test_small_balance_pays_minimum` passes. That test expects 500 for (1800, 45), but the docstring gives 360: 54¢ is raised to the 500¢ minimum and then capped at 1800 // 5 = 360¢. The requester said the docstrings are the source of truth.

Please keep the period and rounding fixes, restore minimum-then-cap, and raise the test/docstring conflict with the team instead of quietly changing the policy in code.
